integrity: The normalization-module and conductor calculations follow from explicit algebraic identities and free-module divisibility arguments; finite symbolic replay is corroboration, not an infinite proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-three fields and the monic affine chart only; no full projective compactification statement.
Equivalent modular conductor calculations could exist in classical invariant-theoretic literature; no claim of literature-exhaustive uniqueness.
The affine reduced hypersurface Jacobian ideal differs from the unreduced resultant presentation and only the former is considered.
title: Frobenius conductor and cubic Jacobian thickening of the characteristic-three universal cubic discriminant
